patent.title: 一种web端业务软件开发框架及方法
assignees: 北京天地和兴科技有限公司
patent.family_note: Ordinary CN invention (Beijing TIP / 天地和兴 industrial cybersecurity; not award textbook). Spec self-names TPF (TIPS PLATFORM CREATE) preferred embodiment; do not treat embodiment branding as E3 product→patent mapping. CNIPA/Google Patents legal-status shows PP01 patent-right preservation registration effective ~2025-08-01 — legal-status context only; do not invent Rights Control fields or raise R from preservation alone. Public company IP narratives name other patents (DDoS / TCP auth / cloud access control), not this grant number.

knowledge_origin.description: Public sources confirm TIP inventorship/assignee for this WEB framework filing, but do not reconstruct whether it originated as an internal platform-engineering track (TPF) versus a product-roadmap feature for a named 天墀/地盾/和睿/兴邦 SKU.

technology.problem: Conventional WEB business-software production requires upfront architecture research and staff training on design norms, lengthening cycle time and raising cost/risk under personnel turnover.
technology.mechanism: Claimed system/method with 规范层 / 开发层 / 封装层: receive user request → generate design-norm data structures and DDL → produce packages via modules (业务注册、网关、认证、通用用户权限管理、日志、具体业务+骨架包工具) → assemble install package via block assembly (e.g. webpack) and packaging tool (e.g. rpmbuild). Spec brands preferred embodiment as TPF (TIPS PLATFORM CREATE).
technology.comparison_baseline: Manual per-project WEB architecture survey + staff norm training without the claimed norm→DDL→modular package→install-pack pipeline (as described in the patent background).

value_carriers.name: 天地和兴工业网络安全 / 平台管理产品线（候选价值载体，映射未确认）

notes: Ordinary (non-textbook) CN invention cold-start — mid-tier industrial cybersecurity firm, not BYD/Huawei/award-star. Deliberately stops at R0: product/IP E2 exists; embodiment TPF name ≠ E3; company news maps other patents to products; PP01 preservation is legal-status context only (not RC schema; not R upgrade). Unknown ≠ 0. Used latest scaffold bibliographic flags. Formal methodology V0.7 / schema 1.0; V0.8 not adopted; no Counterfactual experimental schema.
